messages.author: ae2682c7b8229453
messages.subject: Accessing googlesheets on deployed Shinyapp crashes the server
parts:
Hi, 

My app is basically a form which asks users for information. Then when user presses submit button, it stores that information to a "published" google sheet. The app works fine locally. All data is captured, saved etc. But when I try to run the deployed version, as soon as user presses submit after entering the data, the app "disconnects from server". Here is the link to the app: https://dssg-pathways.shinyapps.io/ExperimentingWithForms/

Please advise
Thanks
